snippet.title: Slime Rancher 2 – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Slime Rancher 2 is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in January 2027, along with an exclusive in-game item!

Slime Rancher 2 is the newest entry in the award-winning smash-hit series Slime Rancher. Journey as Beatrix LeBeau on Rainbow Island, a mysterious land brimming with ancient technology, unknown natural resources, and an avalanche of new slimes to discover.

#IndieWorld #SlimeRancher2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
